children: RNS Number : 1781Z  Legal & General UCITS ETF PLC  16 October 2026
Legal & General UCITS ETF Plc (the “Company”) announces the launch of the following sub-fund of the Company (the “New Sub-Fund”) today:
The shares of the New Sub-Fund are listed on the Official List of the FCA. Dealing in the Shares of the New Share Classes commenced on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange today.

A copy of the Supplement relating to the New Sub-Fund has been submitted to the National Storage Mechanism (NSM) and will shortly be available for inspection at https://data.fca.org.uk/#/nsm/nationalstoragemechanism and www.lgimetf.com.
Certain terms in this announcement are defined in the prospectus for Legal & General UCITS ETF Plc.
